description: Convert energy-profile.html to dark Solar Pro theme (matching report.html) and improve UI quality across all pages. Make the app look professional - better margins, larger headings, proper dark backgrounds, readable forms.
steps: In frontend/pages/energy-profile.html, completely replace the inline <style> block (lines 9-96) with Solar Pro dark theme styles matching the design patterns used in report.html: dark backgrounds (rgba(26,26,46,0.9)), amber/gold accents (#f59e0b), light text (#e2e8f0), dark cards with subtle borders.

Replace the navigation bar at top of energy-profile.html (currently light: background:#f8f9fa) with the same dark steps-bar pattern used in report.html (background:rgba(26,26,46,0.95), border with amber accent, step-active/step-inactive classes).
Fix the header styling: h1 should use amber gradient text like in the main style.css (.header h1). Remove the plain style and use proper dark background.
Fix .form-section: change background from #f8f9fa (white) to rgba(26,26,46,0.9) with border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.15). Fix h3 color from #2c3e50 to #f59e0b.
Fix .hour-table: th background from #3498db to rgba(245,158,11,0.2) with color #f59e0b. td border from #ddd to rgba(245,158,11,0.2). Input backgrounds should be #0f0f1a with light text.
Fix .btn-primary: change from flat #3498db to the gradient style (linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #f97316)) with dark text color #0f0f1a.
Fix .result-box: change from green (#e8f5e9) to dark (rgba(34,197,94,0.1)) with green border and proper dark text.
Fix .result-table: dark theme - th background rgba(245,158,11,0.2) with amber text, td with dark borders.
Fix .warning-box: from light orange (#fff3e0) to dark rgba(245,158,11,0.1) with amber border.
Fix all text colors - labels, spans, p tags should be #e2e8f0 (light) or #94a3b8 (secondary).
Fix the form-row label color to #e2e8f0, input/select styling to use dark background (#0f0f1a) with light text.
Fix checkbox labels to use light text color.
Set default taryfa select to G11f_dynamiczna (should be pre-selected).
Set default zuzycie-bazowe to 250 (user's actual config).
Enable magazyn-aktywny by default and set pojemnosc to 16, godzina-sprzedazy to 23.
In the navigation step indicators: use dark styling matching report.html (step-active for step 2, step-done for completed steps).
Ensure the body background matches the global style.css (dark gradient).
Add appropriate font sizes: h1 at 2rem+, h3 at 1.1rem+, form labels at 0.9rem+.
acceptance_criteria: energy-profile.html uses ONLY dark theme colors - no white/light backgrounds anywhere
The page visually matches the dark Solar Pro design of report.html
All form elements are readable (light text on dark backgrounds)
Default form values: bazowe=250W, pompa CO=3000kWh, CWU=1000kWh, moc pompy=8kW, taryfa=G11f_dynamiczna, magazyn aktywny with 16kWh and sell hour 23
Navigation bar uses dark theme with amber accents
All 400 existing unit tests still pass

Verify dark theme colors are present (rgba(26,26,46, #f59e0b, #0f0f1a, #e2e8f0)
